properties.description: Emits one SecurityAlert per new Halcyon alert with entity mappings. Does NOT create incidents — incident creation is handled by the Halcyon-AlertProcessor playbook.
properties.query:
Halcyon_Commands_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7m)
| join kind=leftanti (_GetWatchlist('HalcyonProcessedIds') | project HalcyonAlertId) on HalcyonAlertId
| join kind=leftanti (
    SecurityAlert
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
    | where AlertName has "Halcyon"
    | extend CustomDetails = parse_json(tostring(parse_json(tostring(ExtendedProperties))["Custom Details"]))
    | extend HalcyonAlertId = tostring(CustomDetails["HalcyonAlertId"][0])
    | where isnotempty(HalcyonAlertId)
    | project HalcyonAlertId
) on HalcyonAlertId
| extend AlertType = tostring(parse_json(tostring(finding_info)).analytic.name)
| extend EvidencesParsed = parse_json(tostring(evidences))
| extend DeviceParsed = parse_json(tostring(device))
| extend Evidence0 = EvidencesParsed[0]
| extend Evidence1 = EvidencesParsed[1]
| extend File1Name = tostring(Evidence0.file.name)
| extend File2Name = tostring(Evidence1.file.name)
| extend Hash0 = Evidence0.file.hashes[0]
| extend Hash1 = Evidence1.file.hashes[0]
| extend FileHashRawAlgorithm = coalesce(tostring(Hash0.algorithm), tostring(Hash1.algorithm))
| extend FileHashRawValue = coalesce(tostring(Hash0.value), tostring(Hash1.value))
| extend FileHashAlgorithm = case(
    FileHashRawAlgorithm == "SHA-256", "SHA256",
    FileHashRawAlgorithm == "Authenticode", "SHA256AC",
    ""
)
| extend FileHashValue = iff(FileHashAlgorithm == "", "", FileHashRawValue)
| extend HostName = iff(AlertType == "BruteForceAttempt", tostring(DeviceParsed.hostname), "")
| extend DstEndpointUid = tostring(Evidence0.dst_endpoint.uid)
| extend DstEndpointSubnetUid = tostring(Evidence0.dst_endpoint.subnet_uid)
| extend IsCidr = DstEndpointSubnetUid matches regex @"^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$"
| extend IsBareIp = DstEndpointUid matches regex @"^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}$"
| extend IsSlash32 = DstEndpointSubnetUid endswith "/32"
| extend CidrMask = iff(IsCidr, extract(@"/(\d{1,2})$", 1, DstEndpointSubnetUid), "")
| extend CidrNetwork = iff(IsCidr, extract(@"^((\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3})/", 1, DstEndpointSubnetUid), "")
| extend IPAddress = case(
    IsBareIp, DstEndpointUid,
    IsSlash32, CidrNetwork,
    IsCidr, CidrNetwork,
    ""
)
| extend IPAddressScope = iff(IsCidr and not(IsSlash32), strcat("/", CidrMask), "")
| extend DNSDomainName = iff(
    AlertType == "NefariousPeer"
        and not(DstEndpointUid contains "*")
        and not(DstEndpointUid contains "/")
        and not(IsBareIp),
    DstEndpointUid,
    ""
)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by HalcyonAlertId
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    HalcyonAlertId,
    AlertType,
    File1Name,
    File2Name,
    FileHashAlgorithm,
    FileHashValue,
    HostName,
    IPAddress,
    IPAddressScope,
    DNSDomainName,
    HalcyonTriageStatus,
    HalcyonDisplayStatus,
    message,
    finding_info,
    evidences,
    device,
    HalcyonSourceTime

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat:
{{message}}.

Halcyon detection for alert ID `{{HalcyonAlertId}}`.

To see related events, run this query in Logs:

HalcyonEvents_CL
 | extend HalcyonAlertId = tostring(parse_json(unmapped)['halcyon_alert_id'])
 | where HalcyonAlertId == '{{HalcyonAlertId}}'
